signature: SUBROUTINE DGEEQU( M, N, A, LDA, R, C, ROWCND, COLCND, AMAX,

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: The M-by-N matrix whose equilibration factors are to be computed.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: r
params.reference: If `INFO = 0` or $\mathrm{INFO} > M$, R contains the row scale factors for A.

params.name: c
params.reference: If `INFO = 0`, C contains the column scale factors for A.

params.name: rowcnd
params.reference: If `INFO = 0` or $\mathrm{INFO} > M$, `ROWCND` contains the ratio of the smallest `R(i)` to the largest `R(i)`. If $\mathrm{ROWCND} \ge 0.1$ and `AMAX` is neither too large nor too small, it is not worth scaling by R.

params.name: colcnd
params.reference: If `INFO = 0`, `COLCND` contains the ratio of the smallest `C(i)` to the largest `C(i)`. If $\mathrm{COLCND} \ge 0.1$, it is not worth scaling by C.

params.name: amax
params.reference: Absolute value of largest matrix element. If `AMAX` is very close to overflow or very close to underflow, the matrix should be scaled.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`,  and i is \<= M:  the i-th row of A is exactly zero
-   `> M`: the (i-M)-th column of A is exactly zero
